summary: GATE-EX0 closes as pass_with_conditions. The EX-0 exam-ingestion contract is adequate to authorize EX-1 as a bounded non-mutating pilot that may create three references/data pilot overlays, while preserving all protected mutation, closure, and student/product-use blocks.

explicit_decisions.decision: Authorize EX-1 to create three bounded non-mutating pilot exam-ingestion overlays under references/data after gate closure.
Keep official exam prompts, source material, official correction models, point rules, decomposition, and gap classifications as governed references/data overlays.
Graph/source-heavy pilot items may not be marked reviewed_ready_for_mapping unless required graph/table/source values are reconstructable or blocking gaps are carried.
EX-1 must add a separate validator for real pilot overlay records.
L-EX0 should make assumed prior knowledge with MTU evidence and deliberately out of scope with reason explicit in the paragraph-plan contract.
Diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, and student-facing output remain blocked.

accepted_outcomes: The EX-0 contract is adequate for a bounded EX-1 pilot.
EX-1 may create three pilot exam-ingestion overlays under references/data.
The overlay-first design is accepted for prompt, source, correction-model, decomposition, and gap-classification records.
Prompt metadata, source annexes, graph/table/figure objects, official answer-model requirements, skill decomposition, MTU classification, and lesson handoff are sufficiently separated for pilot use.
The correction-model fields are the minimum EX-1 contract.
The EX-0 MTU and operation classification taxonomy is accepted for EX-1 and EX-2.
pass_with_gaps is allowed only when named gaps remain visible downstream and block affected use.
blocked_outcomes: No protected reference mutation is authorized.
Do not treat prompt-only extraction as full exam ingestion.
Do not hide source-annex or answer-model gaps downstream.
No diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery decisions, automatic sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.
conditions_to_reopen_or_pass: A graph/source-heavy pilot item may not be marked reviewed_ready_for_mapping unless graph/table/source values needed by the official question are reconstructable, or a blocking graph_object_gap or source_annex_gap is carried.
EX-1 must add a separate validator for real pilot overlay records.
L-EX0 should add explicit paragraph-plan fields for assumed prior knowledge with MTU evidence and deliberately out of scope with reason.
pass_with_gaps may be used only when named gaps remain visible downstream and block affected use.
EX-1 planning must repeat that GATE-EX0 authorizes only non-mutating pilot overlays and no protected mutation or student/product use.
allowed_next_sprint_scope: three bounded exam-ingestion pilot overlays under references/data
explicit source-annex, graph-object, answer-model, precision, unit, and handoff gaps
pilot-overlay validator for real EX-1 records
